subject: website
name: buildsite.eth
summary: A wizard that turns an ENS name into an IPFS-hosted site. Its source is public (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it loads Google Fonts and Reown fonts, calls a visit-counter worker, and its bundled wallet library calls WalletConnect and Coinbase.

connections.name: WalletConnect/Reown (web3modal.org, walletconnect.org, reown fonts)
connections.note: Requests from the bundled wallet library, before any wallet is connected.

connections.name: Coinbase wallet telemetry (cca-lite.coinbase.com)
connections.note: Pings from the bundled wallet library when the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
